description: 3D U-Net inference benchmark for medical image segmentation. Encoder-decoder with skip connections using 3D convolutions (nn.Conv3d), batch norm, and ReLU. Runs forward pass in eval mode with no_grad on synthetic 3D volumes. Reports volumes/sec throughput.

scaling_param.name: batch_size
scaling_param.description: Number of 3D volumes per inference batch

non_scaling_params.name: volume_size
non_scaling_params.description: Size of each spatial dimension (D=H=W) of the input 3D volume

non_scaling_params.name: in_channels
non_scaling_params.description: Number of input channels (e.g., imaging modalities)
